# datacebo-cookbook

This repo hosts tutorials, guide and articles related to using SDV. Notebooks added here are published to our cookbook site.

"One question many users ask is *how much data is enough* to train the synthesizer? Our general advice is to cycle through the following steps until your quality is acceptable for the time it take
"1.  Start with a small sample size of training data (e.g. 1%)\n",
"3.  Measure how long it took for the model to train and synthesize\n",
"4.  Evaluate the quality of the data using [`evaluate_quality`](https://docs.sdv.dev/sdv/multi-table-data/evaluation/data-quality)\n",
